ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption killchain: shadow-copy wipe + recovery disable + AV teardown in <5 min
ucs.description: Hunts the signature LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black pre-encryption sequence — disabling Defender, stopping backup/SQL services, deleting all VSS shadow copies, and breaking Windows Recovery via bcdedit — all from a single host within a tight window. This combo is LockBit's house style (documented in CISA AA23-075A and Mandiant tracking of UNC2165/Bitwise Spider) and rarely co-occurs on a legitimate host.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commandlines values(Processes.process_name) as proc_names dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*delete shadows*","*shadowcopy delete*","*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*","*recoveryenabled no*","*delete catalog*","*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*","*Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath*","*stop *Veeam*","*stop *SQL*","*stop *Backup*","*stop *MSExchange*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_procs >= 3 | rename firstTime as firstTime, lastTime as lastTime | eval window_sec=lastTime-firstTime | where window_sec < 300 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 5m;
let Indicators = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend Tactic = case(
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows", "shadowcopy delete", "delete catalog"), "ShadowWipe",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures", "recoveryenabled no", "recoveryenabled No"), "RecoveryKill",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DisableBehaviorMonitoring", "MpPreference -Disable", "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"), "DefenderTamper",
        FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","SQLAgent","Backup","MSExchange","vss","sophos","AVP","SAVAdminService"), "ServiceKill",
        FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","sqlwriter","veeam","backup","agntsvc"), "ServiceKill",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Tactic)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Tactic;
Indicators
| summarize TacticCount = dcount(Tactic),
            Tactics = make_set(Tactic),
            Cmds = make_list(ProcessCommandLine, 50),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where TacticCount >= 3
| extend WindowSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, WindowSec, DeviceName, AccountName, TacticCount, Tactics, Parents, Cmds
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 5m;
let Indicators = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where AccountType != "Machine"
    | extend Tactic = case(
        CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows", "shadowcopy delete", "delete catalog"), "ShadowWipe",
        CommandLine has_any ("bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures", "recoveryenabled no"), "RecoveryKill",
        CommandLine has_any ("DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DisableBehaviorMonitoring", "MpPreference -Disable", "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"), "DefenderTamper",
        NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe" and CommandLine has "stop" and CommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","SQLAgent","Backup","MSExchange","vss","sophos","AVP"), "ServiceKill",
        NewProcessName endswith "\\taskkill.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("sqlservr","sqlwriter","veeam","backup","agntsvc"), "ServiceKill",
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Tactic)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Tactic;
Indicators
| summarize TacticCount = dcount(Tactic),
            Tactics = make_set(Tactic),
            Cmds = make_list(CommandLine, 50),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, Account, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where TacticCount >= 3
| extend WindowSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, WindowSec, Computer, Account, TacticCount, Tactics, Parents, Cmds
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(4688 OR 1)) AND (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"delete catalog"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR *"Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"*) OR (@Image:(*\net.exe OR *\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*stop* AND (*Veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *MSSQL* OR *SQLAgent* OR *Backup* OR *BACKUP* OR *MSExchange* OR *Sophos* OR *SOPHOS*))) OR (@Image:(*\taskkill.exe OR *\TASKKILL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*sqlservr* OR *veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *agntsvc*)))
ucs.rationale: LockBit affiliates running the StealBit / LockBit Black encryptor invariably run this exact teardown sequence as a single batch (often via the 'lbb.exe -pass <key>' launcher or a bundled .bat). Requiring ≥3 distinct tactic categories within 5 minutes on one host kills FP from individual admin actions (e.g. a backup admin pruning shadows) while still firing on LockBit 2.0, LockBit 3.0/Black, LockBi

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 2.0/3.0 self-spreading via Group Policy: SYSVOL ransomware drop + GPO-deployed scheduled task
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit's distinctive enterprise self-propagation: an operator (typically post-DC-compromise) drops the LockBit encryptor into SYSVOL and modifies a GPO to create a scheduled task or startup script that fetches/executes it on every domain-joined machine. This GPO-abuse propagation method is publicly attributed to LockBit 2.0 in CISA AA22-040A and continues in 3.0/Black — it is not used by most other RaaS crews, making it a high-fidelity LockBit signature.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer_proc values(Filesystem.user) as writers from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*\\Policies\\*" AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" OR Filesystem.file_name="ScheduledTasks.xml" OR Filesystem.file_name="Registry.pol" OR Filesystem.file_name="Groups.xml" OR Filesystem.file_name="Services.xml") AND NOT Filesystem.user IN ("*SYSTEM","*$") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process IN ("*Get-GPO*","*New-GPO*","*Set-GPLink*","*gpupdate*/force*","*schtasks*\\SYSVOL*","*\\\\*\\SYSVOL\\*\\*.exe*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as gpo_cmd] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | table firstTime lastTime dest user file_name file_path writer_proc gpo_cmd
ucs.kql:
let SysvolWrites = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\" and FolderPath has @"\Policies\"
    | where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll"
         or FileName =~ "ScheduledTasks.xml"
         or FileName =~ "Registry.pol"
         or FileName =~ "Groups.xml"
         or FileName =~ "Services.xml"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","network service","local service")
    | project SysvolTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SysvolPath = FolderPath, SysvolFile = FileName,
              SysvolWriter = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SysvolWriterCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SysvolUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let GpoToolUse = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-GPO","Set-GPLink","Set-GPPrefRegistryValue","New-GPLink","Backup-GPO"))
         or (FileName =~ "gpupdate.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/force")
         or (FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "SYSVOL")
         or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"\\\\[^\\]+\\SYSVOL\\[^\\]+\\.*\.(exe|dll)"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project GpoTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, GpoTool = FileName, GpoCmd = ProcessCommandLine, GpoUser = AccountName;
SysvolWrites
| join kind=inner GpoToolUse on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SysvolTime, GpoTime)) <= 30
| project SysvolTime, GpoTime, DeviceName, SysvolUser, SysvolFile, SysvolPath, SysvolWriter, GpoTool, GpoCmd
| order by SysvolTime desc

let GpoToolUse = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("New-GPO","Set-GPLink","Set-GPPrefRegistryValue","Backup-GPO"))

| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SysvolTime, GpoTime)) <= 30

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\SYSVOL\\*\\Policies\\* OR *\\sysvol\\*\\policies\\*)) AND (@TargetFilename:(*.exe OR *.dll OR *ScheduledTasks.xml OR *Registry.pol OR *Groups.xml OR *Services.xml)) -@User:(*SYSTEM* OR *$)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("(?i)\\\\SYSVOL\\\\.+\\\\Policies\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| TargetFileName=/\.(exe|dll)$|ScheduledTasks\.xml$|Registry\.pol$|Groups\.xml$|Services\.xml$/i
| NOT UserName=/(^SYSTEM$|\$$)/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
        | (regex("(?i)(New-GPO|Set-GPLink|Set-GPPrefRegistryValue|Backup-GPO)", field=CommandLine)
           OR (ImageFileName=/\\gpupdate\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)/force", field=CommandLine))
           OR (ImageFileName=/\\schtasks\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)SYSVOL", field=CommandLine))
           OR regex("(?i)\\\\\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\SYSVOL\\\\.+\\.(exe|dll)", field=CommandLine))
        | NOT UserName=/\$$/}, field=aid, include=[CommandLine, ImageFileName, UserName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, TargetFileName], function=[collect([CommandLine], limit=10), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen)])
